pages.title: Home
pages.meta_description: Reliable webhook delivery for engineering teams — one endpoint, retries handled, full replay.

sections.heading: Webhooks that never silently drop
sections.subheading: Ingest, retry, and replay every event your product emits — with a delivery log your customers can see.

sections.heading: Send your first event in four lines

tabs.code:

wg = Woodgrove(os.environ["WG_KEY"])
wg.events.send(type="invoice.paid", data={"id": "inv_42"})
